# BigQuery groups by STRUCTs but rejects them in aggregate functions with DISTINCT:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-types.md
# BigQuery's answer, with a collated field.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT x) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(COLLATE('a', 'und:ci') AS s), STRUCT('A')]) AS x
=> error contains: Aggregate functions with DISTINCT cannot be used with arguments of type STRUCT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(COLLATE('a', 'und:ci') AS s, 1 AS n), ('A', 1), ('b', 1)]) AS x
=> error:

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n), STRUCT(1)]) AS x
=> error:

SELECT ARRAY(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x) OVER () FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n), STRUCT(1)]) AS x)
=> error:
